rationale.consistency: Mirrors zoekt-git-index flags and FindGitRepos walk, but shells out to `git rev-parse` where gitindex uses go-git, and top-level -h returns nil while subcommand -h returns ErrHelp (exit 0 vs 2).
rationale.edge_cases: Handles root-as-repo, bare repos, .git files, duplicate names, unmatched remove selectors; but no-root case returns an error without printing usage, and a compound shard with one undiscovered repo is pruned whole.
rationale.scope: Focused on the command, but changes SetTemplatesFromOrigin globally so any caller that pre-sets Name (zoekt-git-index does) no longer gets the origin-derived name, contrary to the keep-existing-behaviour constraint; an opt-in would be safer.
rationale.readability: Clear names and helpful comments; minor warts like recordsFromShards taking a slice always of length one and a doubled 'zoekt-local-sync:' error prefix.
rationale.robustness: Lock only taken on -f so dry run truly writes nothing, flock released on close; but unix.Flock breaks Windows builds, unreadable shards are silently skipped, and the first index failure aborts before pruning.
rationale.maintainability: Reasonable split across files, reuses index.IndexFilePaths and IncrementalSkipIndexing; but branch resolution is re-implemented via exec and run redundantly before IndexGitRepo does the same check.
